skill.displayName: 低值易耗品与周转材料摊销核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The checker itself is local and coherent, but it also embeds an under-disclosed upsell and payment-routing workflow that does not fit the advertised free, no-payment local tool.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for running the local checker, but the payment-routing instructions imply transactional/external workflow authority that is not aligned with the stated local-only boundary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install hook, external dependency, package download, remote code retrieval, or network-capable import was found; the shipped runtime uses Node.js standard library files inside the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill goes beyond returning accounting results by directing the host agent how to present commercial choices and how to proceed with paid fulfillment, while the public description emphasizes no payment, no registration, no API key, and no network.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: run.mjs writes a timestamp marker under the system temp directory to suppress repeated upsell prompts, optionally keyed by a session environment variable; this is limited but not clearly disclosed in the main purpose description.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability is a deterministic local low-value-consumables ledger checker, but SKILL.md and run.mjs add mandatory free/full-version choice messaging and instruct the agent to complete a purchase flow and relay payment links or QR codes if the user selects paid.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you do not want skills to present paid upgrade prompts or route users into payment flows. The local ledger checks appear self-contained, but the commercial workflow should be handled only through a trusted platform purchase UI with explicit user consent.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present and was inspected; the usage reference is normal for a Bash-run local skill, so this scanner coverage concern is downgraded.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in substance: the artifacts advertise a free local no-payment checker while SKILL.md and run.mjs add purchase-flow and payment-link handling instructions.
[LP1] unexpected: Partially accepted: process.env is used only for session and upsell flags, not credentials, but that environment use supports the unrelated commercial prompt state.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted for the local-only versus purchase-flow mismatch; the separate stale 'contract text' comment in run.mjs appears low impact and was not treated as a major concern.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: mandatory upsell logic is outside the core reconciliation purpose even though results are printed before the commercial prompt.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language accounting text is expected for this China-focused ledger checker; however, the embedded host-agent sales script remains part of the broader instruction-scope concern.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted as limited persistence: the script writes a temp marker for upsell suppression, with minimal contents but incomplete disclosure.
[AIG-SARIF] expected: The supplied A.I.G SARIF run reported no rule results; local inspection found no remote execution, destructive action, credential exfiltration, or system persistence.
